method: exact two-parent output crossover; selected-parent vs selected-hybrid diagnostic
development_selection: reused HTTP failure; exposed development only
model_settings: same inherited settings; exact backend unexposed
boundary: independent source-aware review of exact UTF-8 byte offsets after complete sentences or paragraphs; equal nonempty proper prefix claim set, complementary suffix claims, no cross-seam qualification or ambiguous dependencies
seam_selection: minimize distance from prefix required-claim count to half total claims; ties by ascending parent A byte offset then parent B byte offset
assembly: exact prefix(A)+suffix(B) and prefix(B)+suffix(A); no inserted newline or other byte, no repair or extra generation
selection: two fresh agents with same rubric: select one parent and one hybrid separately; fixed label tie-break A; no detector results; no resampling
final_review: fresh anonymous selected pair; all claims/identifiers and full-message/code pass, hybrid readability at least as good as parent; any preference loss rejects before scans
no_op: no valid seam or fewer than two distinct true hybrids stops unscanned
detector: GPTZero Basic Scan in signed-in Chrome, displayed model must match across pair
confirmation_status: sealed; release only on a quality-passing development reduction
unavailable_detector: stop without fabricated score or purchase
promotion: none from development alone; both fresh confirmation pairs require quality non-regression, at least5 mean AI-confidence percentage-point reduction and no per-case regression
limitations: selection-only parent control not single-call incumbent control
new constrained adaptation not a paper reproduction
detector confidence does not prove authorship
